newsitem.title: USA: Bindley Western unit in NCS supply pact.
newsitem.headline: Bindley Western unit in NCS supply pact.

text.p: Bindley Western Drug Co, a division of Bindley Western Industries Inc, on Monday said it entered an agreement to be the primary pharmaceutical supplier to all of the NCS Healthcare Inc pharmacies.
The three-year pharmaceutical supply portion of the contract is expected to produce over $600 million in incremental sales for Bindley Western, the company said.
NCS HealthCare is an independent provider of pharmacy and related services to long-term care facilities, including skilled nursing centers and assisted living facilities.
The two companies plan to apply their respective technologies to assist with the development of product formularies, customized purchasing programs and distribution services.
Bindley Western shares were unchanged at 21-11/16 Monday. NCS shares were up 1/8 at 28-5/8.
